build_graph_attention_data: build a GraphAttentionData object from AtomicData by preprocessing molecular graphs with radius-based neighbor search and edge features
create_frequency_vectors: create frequency vectors for neighbor attention by computing spherical harmonics from edge direction tensors
compute_bond_orientational_order: compute bond-orientational order per node using spherical harmonics and neighbor direction vectors
generate_attention_mask: generate node attention masks with sincx rotary encoding and graph validity filtering for padded batches
expand_edge_distances: expand edge distances using Gaussian, sigmoid, linear sigmoid, or SiLU smearing basis functions
